trust_tiers.primary: Official project, vendor, standards, or source documentation. Prefer for factual claims and current behavior.
trust_tiers.secondary: Tutorials, landscape reports, community references, and implementation examples. Use for framing after checking primary sources.

metadata.default_source_policy: Use official engine docs first for behavior and syntax. Verify release-sensitive features, cloud limits, and managed-service behavior against current primary docs before recommendations.

postgresql_topics.name: PostgreSQL 18 Asynchronous I/O — Release Notes Detail
postgresql_topics.description: PostgreSQL 18 released 2025-09-25. AIO is GA: new io_method setting (worker / io_uring / sync), pg_aios system view for monitoring in-flight I/Os. Covers sequential scans, bitmap heap scans, and vacuum. Up to ~3x throughput in I/O-bound scenarios per release benchmarks. Use the release announcement and the pg18 release notes (release-18.html) for exact behavior; verify specifics against official docs.

high_signal_guides.name: LITHE: A Query Rewrite Advisor using LLMs (EDBT 2026)
high_signal_guides.description: LLM-based SQL query rewrite research. arXiv 2502.12918 (submitted 2025-02-18, NOT a 2026 arXiv). Published at EDBT 2026. Result on TPC-DS / PostgreSQL: geomean runtime speedup 13.2x vs SOTA 4.9x. Use for framing LLM-assisted query rewriting; verify reproducibility claims independently before citing in recommendations.

high_signal_guides.name: pgvector GitHub — Releases and Documentation

Check for current version before advising on specific index types or query patterns.

high_signal_guides.name: MySQL 9.7 — HyperGraph Optimizer Available in Community Edition
high_signal_guides.description: Oracle announcement confirming HyperGraph optimizer availability in MySQL 9.7 Community Edition (April 2026). Not enabled by default; opt-in per session. Use for framing optimizer discussion; verify exact syntax and defaults against MySQL 9.7 reference manual.
